name: 60 - OpenClaw broker fallback resolver - tailnet private - GPT-Web authored

parameters.content:
GPT-Web authored D-0015-W routing contract.

PRIMARY: canonical VPS OpenClaw health.
FALLBACK: Windows OpenClaw via Tailscale Serve only.

No public ingress, no Funnel, no credential mutation, no provider/model call.
This workflow only resolves a private broker endpoint from health state.
If both are unhealthy it fails closed by returning brokerSelected=none.
Actual authenticated OpenClaw API invocation must use an already-existing safe auth binding; otherwise stop at the credential gate.
